explication: ASu-skills is a Chinese job-search workflow plugin: users invoke one of nine independent career skills, which produce evidence, learning, application, resume, interview, or recruiting-tracker deliverables. The README documents handoffs between selected skills; the graph preserves those documented connections without implying a single mandatory pipeline. Resume export and project-guide utilities have sampled implementation paths. Other skill internals were not sampled, so their nodes point to their documented skill entrypoints and their internal behavior is not expanded.
